description: Which cloud and SaaS providers have an outage open right now, and what did they publish?. Incidents that 39 providers (AWS, Azure, Microsoft 365, Google Cloud, GitHub, Cloudflare, Slack, Zoom, OpenAI, Anthropic, Shopify, Twilio and more) published on their own official status pages, collected every 2 minutes from official public feeds. Every row links to the provider's own incident page. Nothing is estimated or rated. Routes: /open (provider, limit); /same-day (date, limit); /incidents (provider, since, until, impact, limit, offset); /providers (limit). Paid $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /open, /same-day, /incidents, /providers. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: world-outages
